body:
`cupy.random.randint` ignores `size` option if it is a scalar of `cupy.ndarray`. `cupy.random.choice` has the same problem.

numpy: 1.14.5
cupy: 4.2.0

```python
import numpy as np
import cupy

np.random.randint(10, size=np.array(3))  # array([5, 6, 7])
cupy.random.randint(10, size=cupy.array(3))  # array(1)

np.random.choice(np.arange(10), size=np.array(3))  # array([0, 7, 4])
cupy.random.choice(cupy.arange(10), size=cupy.array(3))  # array(9)
```
title: cupy.random ignores size option if it is a scalar on GPU
